description: 3-day soak for container images outside Docker Hub, which have no release dates in Renovate. Needs the renovate-soak caller workflow in the repository: without it these branches never get a pull request.

packageRules.description: Images outside Docker Hub: no timestamp, so the renovate-soak branch status is the soak and the PR opens only after it
prBodyNotes: This image comes from a registry without release dates, so Renovate could not hold it back for the 3-day soak. The `renovate-soak` status did instead: this pull request opened only after the change was 3 days old, and an automerge-eligible update merges on a Renovate run once its checks are green.
